name: mojikumi-workspace
description: Japanese typography compatibility layer for the Web

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @mojikumi/playground
scripts.build:packages: npm run clean && tsc -b packages/core packages/presets packages/dom packages/react packages/rehype packages/mojikumi && node scripts/build-css.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/presets packages/dom packages/react packages/rehype packages/mojikumi --pretty false
